logp.method_description: Aqueous solution of heteronuclear complex (5 mL, 100 μM) was mixed thoroughly with n-octanol (5 mL) ina 15 mL centrifuge tube. The tube was wrapped in aluminium foil, shaken for 24 h in a thermostatic shakerincubator and allowed to settle until the two phases were completely separated. The oil/water distributioncoefficients (log KO/W) were calculated using the relative concentrations of complex in the two phases.[9, 13] Forabsorbance below 0.002, it is used as < 0.002 for log PO/W calculation. The error of log KO/W is ± 0.04.
